prompt:
WeChat article cover image, subject: 点赞十年，才发现取消赞才是这个时代最诚实的动作 — 刷手机的时候，手指在屏幕上滑来滑去，一个赞，两个赞，三个赞。

你可能没注意到，自己已经很久没有认真看过一篇文章了。

点赞变成了一种肌肉记忆。看到标题还行，点一下。看到朋友发的动态，点一下。看到某个观点好像挺有意思，再点一下。整个过程不超过零点五秒。点完就忘。

更微妙的是那个“取消赞”的功能。轻点两下，赞没了。好像什么都没发生过。

我最近在想一个问题——我们到底在赞什么？

## 点赞这件事. Clean minimalist business cover, solid or subtle gradient background, lots of white space, bold modern Chinese typography as the visual focus, no decorative elements, professional and elegant, editorial magazine style. CRITICAL RULES: Do NOT include any text, letters, Chinese characters, or watermarks in the image. Do NOT generate overly smooth, plastic-like, or hyper-saturated AI-art style. Aim for photorealistic or high-quality editorial illustration style. Natural lighting, natural textures, subtle imperfections are preferred. Avoid shiny/glossy effects. Avoid rainbow gradients. Avoid 3D rendered look. The image should look like it was taken by a professional photographer or designed by a human graphic designer.
